rationale: The agent appeared to authenticate by looking up the user and retrieving user details, and it fetched order and product details. However, it performed a write (modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming the change with the user, which violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. It also asserted that the order was updated and a refund issued without showing tool results confirming those outcomes. Additionally, the order ID and item IDs were not confirmed with the user to ensure the correct order/item were being modified. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
